title: Welcome to the Wake
text: The forest whispered 'Leviathan,' Glimmer flew down the path, and now we're standing underneath a rib longer than any building I've ever seen. I would like it officially recorded that I suggested we proceed carefully. Glimmer would like it recorded that I followed anyway.

title: Pressure Has Handwriting
text: The old shelters here don't use painted warnings. They hammer little dents into the walls because anything written down eventually cracks under the pressure. Three dents means danger. Five means turn back. I found one wall with eleven. We chose a different route.

title: The Feeding Scar
text: I thought I found another trench today. Nope. Something enormous dragged its jaw across the seafloor and carved straight through the stone. I stood inside the groove for scale. Glimmer floated very far away before looking back at me. Rude.

title: Shelter Under Scales
text: Apparently travelers used shed Leviathan scales as shelters during pressure storms. I found one big enough for our entire campsite. Glimmer claimed one corner. I claimed the other. We now own beachfront property.

title: Do Not Knock
text: Found a tooth bigger than our campsite. Naturally, I knocked on it. Something knocked back. Glimmer and I have unanimously agreed that this mystery has been fully investigated and requires absolutely no follow-up.

title: The Rib Bridge
text: We crossed a ravine using one enormous rib as a bridge today. Halfway across, I realized I was walking on something's BONE. Glimmer chose that exact moment to bounce on it. I would like a new traveling companion.

title: You Feel Them Before You See Them
text: Old travelers said you could tell when a living Leviathan was passing somewhere beyond the Wake because the currents changed days beforehand. Imagine something so enormous the SEA notices it before you do. Actually, don't imagine that. I already did.

title: The Marrowlight Neighbors
text: Tiny glowing creatures live inside the hollow bones! They've decorated the openings with shells and little bits of starstone. Glimmer tried to visit one. Glimmer has now been formally evicted from a Leviathan vertebra.

title: The Crushed Fleet
text: Seven old ships are tangled together between the bones here. Whatever happened was a very long time ago, so naturally I climbed aboard. Found a captain's hat. Lost the captain's hat. Glimmer is wearing the captain's hat.

title: The Skull Cave
text: WE FOUND A LEVIATHAN SKULL. You can walk inside it. There's an entire little cave ecosystem growing where its mouth used to be. I yelled 'HELLO!' and heard about thirty echoes. Glimmer chimed once and somehow got more echoes than me. Unfair.

title: The Pressure Bell
text: There's an old bronze bell that rings when the pressure becomes dangerous. It stayed quiet all morning. Then it rang once. Glimmer and I looked at each other. It rang twice. We were already leaving before the third.

title: The Wake Without Leviathans
text: The currents still follow the old migration routes even though nobody sees Leviathans traveling them anymore. The creatures are gone, but the sea keeps tracing the paths they used to swim. It's strangely beautiful.

title: A Sky Made of Scales
text: Found a field covered in old Leviathan scales. Every one has a different glowing pattern, and when you look across all of them together it resembles a night sky. Glimmer spent an hour rearranging three. I don't think that's how constellations work, but I'm not stopping it.

title: The Bone Garden
text: Plants have grown over one of the oldest skeletons until the ribs look like enormous garden arches. I found berries growing beneath one. Obviously I tested them. Still alive! Excellent botanical work.

title: Emergency Exit, Enlarged
text: We entered through a gap between two ribs and accidentally slid all the way through the skeleton. I have labeled the place 'Emergency Exit, Enlarged.' Was there an original emergency exit? No. Details.

title: The Listening Bone
text: There's a vertebra here that carries sounds from unbelievably far away. I pressed my ear against it and heard something like singing beyond the Wake. Glimmer chimed into the bone. Something far away seemed to answer. We are pretending that did not happen.

title: The Jaw Bridge
text: Today's bridge was a Leviathan jaw. Do you know how unsettling it is to walk between teeth while simultaneously using the mouth as transportation? Glimmer doesn't. Glimmer enjoyed the entire experience.

title: The Sleeping Skeleton
text: Found a skeleton almost completely buried in sand. Only the curve of its spine is visible, like something enormous sleeping beneath a blanket. I know it's just bones. I KNOW that. I still whispered while we passed.

title: Wakeheart Current
text: The central current pulses in a slow rhythm. Everyone calls it the Wakeheart. Glimmer started chiming along with it. For a while they matched perfectly. Then the current skipped a beat. Glimmer stopped. So did I.

title: Very Large Personal Space
text: Found a claw today. Just the claw. Nothing attached. It is enormous. I made a tiny warning sign and stuck it beside one talon: 'Danger: very large personal space.' Glimmer says the sign is too small. THAT'S THE JOKE, GLIMMER.

title: The Ribcage Camp
text: We made camp inside a ribcage tonight. There's something very strange about using the remains of an ancient sea giant as a tent, but the view is incredible. Glimmer hung little lights between the ribs. Cozy! Horrifying! Cozy-horrifying.

title: Echo Competition
text: Glimmer and I discovered that Leviathan skulls make AMAZING echoes. We held a competition. I yelled. Glimmer chimed. I yelled louder. Glimmer chimed louder. Something VERY far away answered both of us. Competition canceled.

title: A Tooth Full of Lost Places
text: The layers inside one ancient tooth contain traces of plants and minerals from places nobody recognizes anymore. Imagine traveling so far that pieces of forgotten parts of the Astral Sea become part of you. I decided not to knock on this tooth. Character growth.

title: The Leviathan Playground
text: A cluster of curved ribs makes the BEST slides. This is important scientific information. Glimmer disagreed with my chosen route down and raced me. I won. Glimmer claims gravity won. History will remember my version.

title: A Quiet Giant
text: Found one of the most complete skeletons yet. Nothing lives inside it. No glowing plants. No little creatures. Just this enormous Leviathan resting beneath the stars. We sat there for a while without saying anything. Even Glimmer stayed quiet.

title: The Gravewing Route
text: Hundreds of mantas travel through the skeletons at sunset, weaving between the ribs like birds through trees. Glimmer joined them for a while. I'm starting to suspect every glowing creature in the Astral Sea likes Glimmer more than me.

title: The False Leviathan
text: I spent twenty minutes staring at what I thought was another enormous skeleton in the distance. It was a rock formation. Glimmer knew immediately and said nothing. I am beginning to question the ethical standards of Moon Sprites.

title: The Biggest One Yet
text: We found a skull so enormous I couldn't see the other side from where we entered. There are paths inside it. PATHS. Someone left directional markers. One says 'LEFT EYE.' We're exploring a landmark with facial directions now.

title: The Empty Grave
text: At the deepest part of the Wake is an enormous empty space surrounded by Leviathan skeletons. Dozens of them, all facing inward toward the same place. But there's nothing in the center. No bones. No crater. Nothing. Glimmer stayed very close to me while we crossed it. I didn't complain.

title: Beyond the Graveyard
text:
We finally reached the far edge of Leviathan's Wake. Looking back, the bones stretch so far they disappear into the dark. I don't think anyone could ever count how many Leviathans came here—or why this became their resting place.

Ahead is something completely different. Stone roads. Broken towers. Old banners caught in the current. I can see the remains of an entire kingdom beneath the water.

Glimmer found a tiny crown-shaped piece of metal and has been wearing it for twenty minutes.

Fine. Your Majesty.

Sunken King's Throne it is~
